introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, curve your back upward and let your head come down. Repeat the exercise.

Do it slowly with each step of this exercise.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Tilt your head towards your left shoulder and then to the right. 

Don’t move your shoulders when you tilt your head.
name: HEAD TILT

tips.text: Please don\'t move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Place one arm across your body, parallel to the ground, then use the other arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. \n\nHold for a while, switch arms and repeat the exercise. Keep the inside arm straight during the exercise.
name: SHOULDER STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your right leg up and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor. 

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your left leg up and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your legs extended. Lift your left knee up and grab it with both hands. 

Pull your left knee towards your chest as much as you can while keeping your right leg straight on the ground. 

Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Breathe naturally.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your legs extended. Lift your right knee up and grab it with both hands. 

Pull your right knee towards your chest as much as you can while keeping your left leg straight on the ground. 

Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Breathe naturally.

introduce: Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. \n\nSlowly bend your right arm; meanwhile, bend your upper body to the right. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. \n\nSlowly bend your left arm; meanwhile, bend your upper body to the left. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie down on your back with your legs extended.\n\nBend your knees and bring them up toward your chest; hug your knees with both hands. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.\n\nLift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.\n\nLift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your right leg with your right foot close to your left thigh.\n\nLean your upper body forward. Hold this position.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your left leg with your left foot close to your right thigh.\n\nLean your upper body forward. Hold this position.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands at your sides. \n\nLift your left leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with your hands. Keep this position.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides. \n\nLift your right leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with your hands. Keep this position.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs stretched, hands at your sides and palms up. Take deep relaxation on the floor.\n\nTake deep breaths through your nose. Connect your body to the breath.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Take deep breaths through your nose.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your left knee forward, and place your left foot on the outside of your left elbow. Drop your right leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your right knee forward, and place your right foot on the outside of your right elbow. Drop your left leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start with your right knee on the ground, and your left leg straight forward. \n\nTry to reach your upper body down to your left leg. Hold this position.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce: Start with your left knee on the ground, and your right leg straight forward. \n\nTry to reach your upper body down to your right leg. Hold this position.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce: Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and press your knees down as much as possible. \n\nPlace your hands in front of you, and try to lean forward. Hold this position.
name: EASY BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Breathe deeply.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders. 

Extend your left arm up to the sky, then thread your left arm underneath your body until your shoulder and ear are lowered to the floor.

Reach your right arm overhead. Breathe deeply. Hold this position.
name: THREAD THE NEEDLE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your hips directly above your knees during the exercise.
Don\'t collapse your right shoulder into your neck.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and upper back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders. 

Extend your right arm up to the sky, then thread your right arm underneath your body until your shoulder and ear are lowered to the floor.

Reach your left arm overhead. Breathe deeply. Hold this position.
name: THREAD THE NEEDLE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your hips directly above your knees during the exercise.
Don't collapse your left shoulder into your neck.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and upper back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start on all fours with your hips up in an upside-down \'V\' shape. Alternately lift and lower your heels.\n\nBreathe regularly throughout the pose.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Breathe regularly.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position, but with your right leg on the floor. Tuck your pelvis in and sink your hips. 

Raise your arms up by your ears with your palms facing each other. Look straight ahead. Hold this position.

Take full and deep breaths. Lengthen your spine each time you exhale.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position, but with your left leg on the floor. Tuck your pelvis in and sink your hips. 

Raise your arms up by your ears with your palms facing each other. Look straight ahead. Hold this position.

Take full and deep breaths. Lengthen your spine each time you exhale.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
